note: post_process_1pass() in jdpostct.c forwards its output_buf parameter straight into cinfo->cquantize->color_quantize() with no NULL check. When a caller discards scanlines (jpeg_skip_scanlines()), output_buf is legitimately NULL while num_rows can still be nonzero. color_quantize dispatches to quantize_ord_dither() in jquant1.c, whose first per-row action is jzero_far((void *) output_buf[row], ...) -- a write through the unchecked, possibly-NULL pointer, causing a NULL pointer dereference and a crash/denial of service on a crafted or ordinary JPEG input decoded with scanline-skipping enabled.

traces.message: output_buf parameter received unchecked; NULL when the caller is discarding scanlines (jpeg_skip_scanlines path)
(*cinfo->cquantize->color_quantize)(cinfo, post->buffer, output_buf + *out_row_ctr, (int) num_rows); : forwards the unchecked output_buf onward with no NULL guard
jzero_far((void *) output_buf[row], (size_t) (width * sizeof(JSAMPLE))); : dereferences output_buf[row] with no prior NULL check -- NULL pointer dereference sink
